items.source: Example: web.xml, mapping all "/myservlet" requests to a Spring dispatcher. Also defines a custom "myServlet", but without servlet mapping.
items.translation: 示例：web.xml，将所有"/myservlet"请求映射到 Spring 分发器。 还定义了一个自定义的"myServlet"，但没有servlet 映射。

items.source:
Useful to invoke an existing servlet via Spring's dispatching infrastructure,
for example to apply Spring HandlerInterceptors to its requests. This will work
even in a minimal Servlet container that does not support Servlet filters.
items.translation: 通过 Spring 的分发基础设施调用现有的 servlet 很有用，例如对其请求应用 Spring HandlerInterceptors。即使在不支持 Servlet 过滤器的最小 Servlet 容器中，此方法也能正常工作。

items.source: Default is the bean name of this controller.
items.translation: 默认值为该控制器的 Bean 名称。

items.source:
Performs a check whether an include URI attribute is found in the request,
indicating an include request, and whether the response has already been committed.
In both cases, an include will be performed, as a forward is not possible anymore.
items.translation: 检查请求中是否存在包含 URI 属性以指示包含请求，以及响应是否已提交。在这两种情况下，都将执行包含操作，因为此时无法再进行转发。
true 用于包含，false 用于转发

items.source: Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init callback such as InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet() or a custom init-method.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但在初始化回调（如InitializingBean.afterPropertiesSet()）或自定义 init-method 之前调用。

items.source: Determine whether to use RequestDispatcher's include or forward method.
items.translation: 确定是使用 `RequestDispatcher` 的 `include` 还是 `forward` 方法。

items.source: Template method. Subclasses must implement this. The contract is the same as for handleRequest.
items.translation: 模板方法。子类必须实现此方法。其契约与 `handleRequest` 相同。

items.source: Set the name of the bean in the bean factory that created this bean.
items.translation: 在创建此 Bean 的 Bean Factory 中设置该 Bean 的名称。

items.source: name - the name of the bean in the factory. Note that this name is the actual bean name used in the factory, which may differ from the originally specified name: in particular for inner bean names, the actual bean name might have been made unique through appending "#..." suffixes. Use the BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String) method to extract the original bean name (without suffix), if desired.
items.translation: name - 工厂中 Bean 的名称。请注意，此名称是工厂中实际使用的 Bean 名称，可能与最初指定的名称不同：特别是对于内部 Bean 名称，实际的 Bean 名称可能已通过追加"#..."后缀使其唯一化。如需提取原始 Bean 名称（不带后缀），请使用BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String)方法。
